1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line spacing, though letter spacing appears standard rather than especially generous.

2.why: Instructions are sentence-case, non-italic, short lines, but the 'NORTHSTAR BANK' header is rendered in all-caps on every screen.

3.why: Content sits in a narrow single-column card with large text and full-width buttons that would fit a mobile viewport, though the screenshots themselves are desktop-width so actual mobile rendering is not directly confirmed.

4.why: Each screen carries only one or two short plain sentences, e.g. 'Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone. The code expires in 10 minutes.'

5.why: The phone field shows an example placeholder '+447700900000', but the email and verification code fields show no example of the expected input.

6.why: No screen contains more than a two-sentence instruction block, so no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: The six-digit code must be read from a separate SMS and typed into the field, and no copy button or copyable secret appears anywhere in the flow.

8.why: No QR code or any alternative to manual entry is shown on any of the five screens, and the authenticator setup step never appears.

9.why: The form uses plain inputs that browsers typically autofill, but there is no password field and no visible evidence (attributes, prompts) confirming autofill or password manager support.

10.why: Each screen shows a 'Step X of 3' label and a large high-contrast dark-teal primary button ('Continue', 'Verify and continue') that clearly dominates the layout.

11.why: Every screen asks for exactly one main action via the primary button, with only a visually subordinate 'Use different details' option alongside.

12.why: Moving from step 1 to step 2 confirms a code was sent, but after the failed attempt the banner 'We could not complete that request' does not plainly state what actually happened.

13.why: Retry and 'Use different details' are available without visible penalty, but there is no reveal/hide toggle on the code field and no option to re-request or resend the code.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' avoids blaming the user and suggests retrying, but it never states what the problem was or how to fix it specifically.

15.why: No reading time limit is imposed on any screen, and while the code carries a 10-minute expiry, that is a reasonably generous entry window rather than a tight countdown.
